candidate.answerReason: In five hours their solo rates would produce 19/18 of a chimney. Talking costs 50 bricks, so 50 bricks represent 1/18 of the chimney, giving 900 bricks.

methods.label: Compare the lost bricks with a fraction of the chimney
methods.explanation:
Measure the work in whole chimneys. In five hours at her solo rate, Brenda would build \(5/9\) of the chimney. Brandon would build \(5/10=1/2\). Without the decrease in output, their combined work in five hours would therefore be
\[
\frac59+\frac12=\frac{19}{18}=1+\frac1{18}
\]
of a chimney.

Talking decreases their combined output by \(10\) bricks per hour, so over five hours they produce \(5\cdot10=50\) fewer bricks. Since they finish exactly one chimney, those \(50\) lost bricks correspond to the extra \(1/18\) of a chimney that their solo rates would have produced.

The entire chimney therefore contains
\[
18\cdot50=\boxed{900}\text{ bricks},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses fractions of one job, rate times time, and recovery of a whole from a known fractional part. Algebraic equation solving is unnecessary.
